titulo: XXL Valentine's Day Inflatable Heart with 2 Love, Romantic Decoration, Special Night, Party of Love, Window Showcase, Surprise your partner by expressing how much you love them
bullets: Romantic decoration – for Valentine's Day, special nights and love parties.
Includes: 1 giant red heart, 2 "Love" balloons and reusable inflation straw.
REUSABLE - The elements are inflated and deflated with the straw included in the package. To deflate them, you have to insert the straw enough until the air starts to come out.
ECO-FRIENDLY PRESENTATION - Packed in a kraft envelope, no extra plastics.
Very light: they are easily attached to any stand with a clamp because they weigh very little.
HEAVY DUTY - They hold inflated without decaying for a long time and not easy to puncture.
descripcion_html:
Surprise your lover with our party decorations for lovers, perfect for any romantic occasion. This set includes a giant red heart shaped balloon and two smaller balloons that form the word "Love", creating an atmosphere full of love. Ideal for Valentine's Day, special evenings, love parties and window dressing.

Inflation and deflation instructions
The set comes with a 6" reusable plastic straw that serves both inflating and deflating the elements. To do this, you must insert the straw through the valve until it exceeds the length of an internal section measuring 8 cm. To inflate and deflate the balloons, insert the straw through the valve 8 cm.
